A studio-built website template you buy once, own outright, and host for free.

You don't own your website. You're leasing it.

Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Shopify, Framer. They all work the same way. You don't pay for a website. You pay, every month, for permission to keep yours switched on.

Miss a payment and it goes dark. The price goes up and you absorb it. They retire a feature, change a layout tool, or move you to a new plan, and you reorganise your business around their decision. You're not a customer with an asset. You're a tenant.

And the rent never stops. Three years on a builder is $1,000 to $1,800, often more. Five years is closer to $2,000 to $3,000. At the end of it, you still own nothing. Stop paying and there is nothing to show for all of it.

The old way out was to commission a custom coded site: $3,000 to $15,000, and a developer on call every time you wanted to change a sentence. So most service providers never had a real choice. You rented, because renting was the only door that was open.

For the first time, there's a third option.

A custom coded website used to mean a developer: to build it, and to touch it ever again. That's the only reason builder subscriptions made sense.

AI changed the second half of that. A custom coded site can now be edited by anyone who can describe what they want. No developer on retainer. No drag and drop builder to learn. The thing that made custom code impractical for a solo business owner is simply gone.

Groundwork is built for that moment. A real, custom coded website you own, and can actually run yourself.

A website you own. Hosting that's free. Edits in plain English.

Groundwork is a complete website template of ten pages. It is custom coded, designed to convert, and ready to publish. You buy it once. The files are yours. You host it free on Netlify, with no monthly subscription to anyone.

When something needs to change, you don't open a builder. You write what you want:

“Swap the hero image for the new one.”

“Add a page for the June retreat.”

“Change the booking button to my Calendly link.”

“Rewrite the About page in a warmer tone.”

Two ways to make those changes, both in plain English:

In your browser.

Describe the change, let the agent make it, review the preview, publish. You pay only for the editing you actually use. There’s no fixed monthly fee, and nothing to pay in the months you don’t touch the site.

On your computer, with Claude Code.

Unlimited edits, no cost per change. When you’re happy, you publish for free.

Either way, there are no theme settings to hunt through and no template builder to master. You describe it; it’s done. Text, images, new pages, button links, whole sections, all of it.

Before you buy.

Do I need to know how to code?+

No. If you can describe the change you want in a sentence, you can run this website. That’s the whole idea.

What does it cost to keep the site online?+

Nothing. Groundwork is hosted on Netlify's free tier, with no monthly hosting fee. The only thing you might pay for is editing in the browser, and only for what you use. Edit with Claude Code instead and even that is unlimited, with no cost per change.

Can I use my own domain name?+

Yes. Connect any domain you own, or one you buy. It's your site.

Will my website look like everyone else's?+

No. Once it carries your words, images, colours and brand, it reads as yours. Prefer we handled that? Add Customisation. The structure is shared; the result isn't.

What exactly do I get?+

The full template of ten pages (Home, About, Product, Reviews, Contact, Contact Success, Apply, Apply Success, Privacy Policy, 404), a tutorial on editing with Claude, and a tutorial on connecting Google Analytics.

Is it really mine?+

Yes. You receive the website files and you own them. No platform sits between you and your own site.

Can you set it up for me?+

Yes. Add the setup and launch extra, and we'll deploy it, connect your domain, wire up analytics, and hand it over live.

What's your refund policy?+

Groundwork is a digital product, delivered instantly on purchase, so all sales are final. If you're not certain it's the right fit, book a quick call before you buy. We're glad to talk it through first.
